newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait's cabinet sends 97/98 budget bill to Emir.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait's cabinet sends 97/98 budget bill to Emir.

text.p: Kuwait's cabinet on Sunday approved the 1997/98 (July-June) state budget bill and presented it to the Emir, Sheikh Jaber al-Ahmad al-Sabah, ahead of sending it to parliament, a cabinet statement said.
The statement released after the cabinet's weekly meeting did not give the figures for the proposed budget.
A newspaper earlier this month said the 1997/98 projected deficit fell to 1.139 billion dinars ($3.76 billion) compared to 1.21 billion in 1996/97.
The projected deficit stands at about 13 percent of an estimated 1996 Gross Domestic Product (GDP) of around 8.6 billion dinars by current prices.
The bill needs to be approved by parliament and the emir before it becomes law.
Officials have said they plan to eliminate the deficit by the year 2000, a target that economists say would be hard to achieve without serious reforms that have not been introduced.
